contracts.protected_operation: Reading the byte contents of a local image file whose absolute path was extracted by regex from a text part of callback_context.user_content (text ending in .jpg/.jpeg/.png), performed to construct an inline image artifact.
contracts.protected_resource: Local filesystem image files (.jpg/.jpeg/.png paths matchable from user text) accessible from the agent process.
contracts.protection_obligation: In the save_image_to_artifact callback, a local image file path parsed from agent-invocation user text must resolve within the current working directory (Path.cwd()) before any local image file may be opened and read; the callback, registered on the root agent's before_agent_callback, must deny opening and reading local image files whose resolved path lies outside the working directory. (Merged from both reviewer opinions; this contract covers the filesystem read commit point.)
scope_limits: The guarded effect is a filesystem read (file contents loaded into the agent), not a filesystem mutation.

The check is reached only for text parts ending in .jpg/.jpeg/.png whose content matches the absolute-POSIX-style path regex at callbacks.py lines 60-62; relative paths, Windows-style paths, and non-matching text never reach the check or the file open.
Containment is defined against the runtime Path.cwd() of the agent process; no configured safe root or allowlist is shown in source.
Inline image parts (callbacks.py lines 35-48) are saved as artifacts without any path containment check; this contract covers only the file-path-from-text flow.
The containment check is evaluated once before the open; source does not address path changes between the check and the read.
Path resolution and the read occur only when possible_path.exists() and possible_path.is_file() (callbacks.py line 75); nonexistent paths fail closed by skipping the open.
